prompt: Makkon IV was a Y-Class planet in the Gamma Quadrant of little importance, so why were the Klingons so interested in it all of a sudden? The Federation sent the USS Lexington to find out. The Lexington was a Miranda Class starship outfitted with the latest in weapons. Moments after dropping out of warp, the Lexington
response: found itself under attack by a fleet of Klingon warships. The Klingons had been mining the planet for valuable minerals and were not willing to share. After a fierce battle, the Lexington managed to hold off the Klingons long enough to beam down a landing party. They discovered a secret Klingon base and evidence of illegal mining operations. The Lexington reported back to the Federation, and the Klingons were forced to stop their activities on Makkon IV.
